command: node --import tsx --test src/replay.integration.test.ts (test: restart hydration rebuilds the same graph as live ingest (P0-G5)); full-ledger replay of a scratch copy of the P0-1 snapshot via rehydrate()
notes: Mutation check: restoring lastObserved = Date.now() in addEdge makes the test fail. Constructor-time ecosystem seeds are pinned to one fixed time in the test; event projection runs on the real clock, so any remaining wall-clock read in the projection path would show as a diff. Out of scope and left for Phase 1 (P1-G3): boot-time seedFromPastEvents/seedCommsFromPastEvents and the category normalization still read the wall clock and run at a point in time, so a long-running daemon and a restarted one still differ by the topics created since boot (normalization removes TOPIC nodes at boot by design, commit 291d9df). Entity lastActive/activation and edge weight are outside this gate: the live path also decays on the wall clock in ingestObservation. Graph time is device time capped at the stored server time, so a skewed device clock cannot pin it in the future.
